containerVersion.name: Add GA4 event tracking tags, triggers, and variables
containerVersion.description:
Tags:
* Added "Google tag - Atelier Nord" triggered by "Initialization - All Pages".
* Added GA4 e-commerce tags ("add_shipping_info", "add_payment_info", "add_to_cart", "remove_from_cart", "view_cart", "begin_checkout", "purchase", "view_item", "select_item", "view_item_list") and associated triggers.
* Added GA4 custom event tags ("search", "filter_products", "sort_products", "select_variant", "apply_coupon", "coupon_error", "free_shipping_unlocked", "update_cart_quantity", "checkout_error", "click_cta", "page_view") and associated triggers.

Variables:
* Added Data Layer variables for user properties and event parameters.
* Added "Event Settings - User Properties" and "CONST - GA4 Measurement ID" variables.
